title: The Wide River's Forgetting Where Lessons Dissolve Into Tide

features.name: the unlearning current
features.desc-on-touch: Water that flows with enough force to wash away everything it taught you. Each bend erases the lessons of the bend before it.

features.name: the sediment-reversal
features.desc-on-touch: The river deposits what it forgot. Mud that once meant instruction now means only mud. The landscape fills with meaningless drift.

features.name: the delta-dispersal
features.desc-on-touch: Where the river stops being one thing and becomes many small things. Teaching ends not with a conclusion but with dissipation.

features.name: the tide-remembers
features.desc-on-touch: Salt water moving in and out, erasing and rewriting. The tide doesn't care what the river taught; it teaches its own lesson—arrival and departure, arrival and departure.

features.name: the mouth-opening
features.desc-on-touch: The river finally lets go. Everything it carried enters the wide water and becomes indistinguishable from everything else. Lessons dissolve. The river stops teaching and starts disappearing.

inscription: the river forgot its own path as it widened; teaching ends not with understanding but with the dissolution of the teacher into something too large to know itself

file.name: River_Mouth_Study_Tidal_Variance_Long_Record.mp3
file.note: Sound recordings from the delta across decades. The river's voice changes as tides rise and fall. In newer recordings, the river's song becomes harder to distinguish from the sea's.
